description: Find free times for a 30-minute call with Lentra on cal.com. purpose intro (default) is for property owners and operators; investor is for investors.

from.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. Default now.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the returned times, e.g. Europe/Madrid.

to.description: End of the range. Default 7 days after from; at most 21 days.

name: find_call_slots
title: Find call times
